messages.author: dab85ab569953d94
messages.subject: Can't load INLA after upgrade
parts:
Hi inla discussion group,

I upgrade inla using inla.upgrade() today and then I have problem loading the INLA library:
> library(INLA)
Loading required package: Matrix
Loading required package: lattice

Attaching package: 'Matrix'

The following object(s) are masked from 'package:base':

    det

Loading required package: pixmap
Loading required package: sp
Error : package 'pixmap' does not have a name space
In addition: Warning messages:
1: package 'INLA' was built under R version 2.13.1
2: package 'Matrix' was built under R version 2.13.1
Error: package/namespace load failed for 'INLA'


I tried to reinstall install by command source("http://www.math.ntnu.no/inla/givemeINLA.R") but it won't install correctly. I have tried it under both R 2.10.0 and R 2.13.0. Same error messages and same problems. What is going on?

Many thanks!
Cici

messages.author: dab85ab569953d94
messages.subject: Re: Can't load INLA after upgrade
parts:
Ok, looks like I need to get the latest version of pixmap library and then INLA loads correctly.

Thanks!

messages.author: 8dbb28b015bb7762
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Can't load INLA after upgrade
parts:
Hi Cici.
The problem has been discussed a couple of months ago in the list
http://www.r-inla.org/comments-1?place=topic%2Fr-inla-discussion-group%2Fv6LvjO14pfQ%2Fdiscussion

Indeed, you have to reinstall INLA.
You don't mention what problem you had with the reinstallation.
Try removing the local library first, and then running the script.
Also, you can try "the regular way" http://www.r-inla.org/download

Good luck.
        ƒacu.-
